in_arabic.name: معان
in_arabic.meaning: المعنى الحقيقي للاسم معان هو المعنى أو الفهم العميق
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم معان مشتق من الجذر العربي 'م-ع-ن' الذي يعني الفهم العميق أو المعنى الحقيقي. يستخدم هذا الاسم في الثقافة الإسلامية ليعبر عن الفهم الدقيق والتفسير العميق للنصوص الدينية أو الشعرية. كما أنه يرتبط بالقدرة على استخلاص المعاني من الكلمات أو العبارات.

in_urdu.name: معان
in_urdu.meaning: معان کا مطلب ہے گہرا مطلب یا حقیقی معنی
in_urdu.long_meaning: معان نام عربی جڑ 'م-ع-ن' سے ماخوذ ہے جس کا مطلب ہے گہرا مطلب یا حقیقی معنی۔ یہ نام جنوبی ایشیائی اسلامی ثقافت میں گہری سمجھ اور نصوص کی تفسیری اہمیت کے لیے استعمال ہوتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: मान
in_hindi.meaning: मान का अर्थ है गहरा अर्थ या वास्तविक अर्थ
in_hindi.long_meaning: मान नाम अरबी मूल 'म-ع-न' से लिया गया है जिसका अर्थ है गहरा अर्थ या वास्तविक अर्थ। यह नाम भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में गहरी समझ और धार्मिक ग्रंथों की व्याख्या के लिए प्रयोग किया जाता है।

in_pashto.name: معان
in_pashto.meaning: د معان مطلب دا دی گړی معنی یا حقیقي معنی
in_pashto.long_meaning: معان نوم د عربي ريښې 'م-ع-ن' څخه اخیستل شوی دی چې معنی یې دى گړی معنی یا حقیقي معنی. دا نوم د افغان او پښتون قومونو په دودیزو کړاوو کې د ژور پوهاوي او مذهبي متنونو د تفسیر لپاره کارول کېږي.

in_english.name: Maan
in_english.meaning: Maan means profound meaning or deep understanding
in_english.long_meaning: The name Maan is derived from the Arabic root 'م-ع-ن' (maʿana), which signifies profound meaning or deep understanding. In Islamic tradition, it is associated with the ability to extract and comprehend deeper meanings from religious texts or poetry. Historically, the name reflects a valuable trait of intellectual and spiritual depth.

data.cultural_impact: 'Maan' is a name deeply rooted in Islamic tradition, evoking a sense of strength and resilience. It is a reminder of the unwavering faith of Prophet Yunus, who, despite being cast into the depths of the sea, never lost his conviction in Allah's mercy and forgiveness.
data.spiritual_significance: The name 'Maan' carries immense spiritual significance as it reflects the ideals of steadfastness, faith, and submission to Allah. It serves as a constant reminder for individuals to remain steadfast in their faith and to maintain unwavering trust in Allah's plan and guidance, no matter the circumstances. Like the Prophet Yunus, we too must exemplify strength in our beliefs and unwavering commitment to our faith, even when faced with adversity.

historical_references.reference:
Maan was an important caravan station and trade center on the Incense Route, located in present-day Jordan. It was ruled by various Arab tribes, the Nabataeans, the Romans, and the Lakhmid dynasty before the rise of Islam.
Source: Encyclopaedia Britannica.
historical_references.time_period: Pre-Islamic period to early Islamic period (circa 3rd century BCE to 7th century CE)
historical_references.context: Historical significance as a major trading post

historical_references.reference:
Maan is mentioned in the Quran as the place where the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) and his companions spent some time during their journey from Mecca to Medina, and where they were hospitably received by the people of Maan. This event is recorded in Surah Al-Anfal (8:41-42).
Source: Sahih International.
historical_references.context: Historical importance as a place of refuge for the Prophet Muhammad and his companions
